items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Tony's still living, I think. He's in Chicago. No, he's in New York.

ctx.x: I really don't have it. First time I've seen it, I heard it.
Did you ever see this book called They All Played Ragtime? No, I did not. Well, let's look at this third paragraph here. Tony Perrini, the New Orleans clarinet player.
Tony's still living, I think. He's in Chicago. No, he's in New York.
